Attendance is the license to start the days work.On press Attendance Users marked as present with date and Time Tag. This Menu can be found on the right hand top corner of the Menu Page just after Login.

COLLECTION can be of 2 types. 
i.Bill 2 Bill Collection 
ii.On Account Collection 

Bill 2 Bill Collection : Flow is same as Order Collection. 
1.ROUTE SELECTION 
2.CUSTOMER SELECTION - Only those who have Outstanding. 
3.INVOICE SELECTION - User has to choose an Invoice from Outstanding list. 
4.ENTER AMOUNT - User has to enter the Amount to be collected.If Collected amount is less than the Outstanding Amount then APP will ask whether the remaining amount is as discount or not. 
5.Click Go For Payment. 

On Account Collection : User has to enter Amount and Click Go For Payment. 

6.User need to specify the Mode of Collection between 
i.Cash 
ii.CHEQUE Collection 
iii.NEFT 
iv.RTGS 
v.IMPS. 
7.User has to provide other details such as DATE,BANK NAME,CHEQUE No./TRANSACTION No.,Remarks 
8.Press SUBMIT to complete the transaction.

Normal procedure like Order & Collection. 
1. Need to select Customer from the list. 
2. Automatically Camera become active and user need to capture desired image and to submit. 
 3.This analyze and verify whether merchandising activity has been performed by outsource agencies or not.

1.ROUTE SELECTION : User has to select a Route from the List of Route(s). 
2.CUSTOMER SELECTION : User has to select the Customer from the List of Customers(s). 
3.AVAILABLE CREDIT LIMIT (Optional): If this option is enabled then user can view that current Credit Limit. 
4.PRODUCT SELECTION : Product Selection is done on Hierarchical basis based on Product Filter number. 
i.Selection of BRAND / GROUP / CATEGORY 
ii.Selection of BRAND FORM/ SUB GROUP / SUB CATEGORY 
iii.Selection of BRAND SUB FORM / SUB SUB GROUP /SUB SUB CATEGORY 
iv.Selection of SKU 
5.Qty(Mandetory) - This is a must entered field. 
6.MRP/Sale Rate(SETUP Defined) - User can select from a List of MRP or can input the same. 
7.Cl Stk(SETUP Defined) - User can see the Cl Stk of the SKU of his respective Depoy/Warehouse. 
8.TD(SETUP Defined) - User can input the TD for that SKU. 
9.ADD TO CART : Once the order has been freezed for that particular SKU user need to press this button. Upon press the same user can see the Order Value on Top of Available Credit Limit. User can choose multiple SKU's in asingle Order Form just using above mentioned procedure. 
10.CHECK OUT : Once Order Process has been completed press this button which will lead to Final Order Form. 
Final Order Form shows the Details of Per Line Call information. User can Edit any of the Inputs by pressing once on the line. It will appear to edit the inputs. User may also DELETE that Line by LONG PRESS on the line. 
Before Submit the Final Order User can enter following : 
i.REMARKS/DELIVERY INSTRUCTION. 
ii.PAYMENT MODE 

NO ACTIVITY : Present at Top Right Hand Corner of Order Form,this is to confirm that User has visited the Customer but No Activity happened.

User gets a comprehensive total outstanding list for his all customers. \nThis list provides Customer wise TOTAL OUTSTANDING and on click of a particular Customer list provides Invoice wise outstanding along with no. of days that particular days that invoice is pending.

User can register the meeting a new Lead or Business Prospect for future business. 
1. User needs to input Prospects Name, Address, Pin Code & Phone No. all are mandatory inputs. Area is auto filled mode from Users Routeé/Beat Plan.After feeling the basic info,press Next. 
2.User need to Select the Product/SKU he has discussed with prospect. 
3.User need to click Submit to complete transaction

On Press ROUTE PLAN a CALENDER opens. User need to LONG PRESS a date to get the list of his Market/Beat . User need to select the Route(s) for that day. User can create a NEW ROUTE also by selecting ADD NEW ROUTE.\nOnce User has defined the Route,he need to press SUBMIT to confirm. It leads back to CALENDER SCREEN. User need to press SUBMIT to complete the transaction.\nOnce submitted User can change the Plan too. Long Press the Date for which date he needs to change. There User can ADD another Route and/or can also Delete the previously slected Routes.

A unique tool to monitore the stock movement of a particular product and/or group of products and/or focus products and/or price protection.Very simple to use 
1. Need to select the CUSTOMER. 
2. Select the PRODUCT from list 
 3.INPUT the SHELF STOCK of that particular PRODUCT of that selected CUSTOMER. 

(SETUP Defined)Users can also scan the BARCODE of the stock lying at CUSTOMER-END and crosscheck whether that particular is eligible to get PRICE PROTECTION or not.

The Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act was passed in early August of 2023. The act is expected to come into force to companies like us anytime through a government notification.


Due to this ‘Personal Data’ of any individual (employee, dealer, customer, business partner) is extreme critical and sensitive entity of any organisation and we need to take outmost protection and privacy of such ‘data’ and this is to be informed via our ‘ Privacy Policy’ to whosever who visits to our websites. Please note any violation in particular for the failure to implement information security measures necessary to mitigate the risk of a personal data breach - could result in fines of up to 250 crore INR/$30 million.


In connection to the above in our recent revamped website, I found some changes is needed and my drafted Privacy Policy is attached for your reference.


Also, I found my name and mobile number is visible in the policy, mentioned as ‘Grievance Officer (as per requirement of Information Technology Rules)’ without my knowledge and consent. Nowhere any person name/contact details should be written, and instead of only email id and contact number should be displayed. You may give email / contact no for our Legal Officer, who can connect us (IT Dept.) later any IT related issues.


You can enquire/check with other websites or related website design vendor.
